jargon.explain: 赚的钱减去必须花的钱后，真正落袋的现金。FCF为负=花得比赚得多。
jargon.explain_en: Earnings minus mandatory spending, actual pocketed cash. Negative FCF = spending exceeds earnings.

jargon.term: 社零（社会消费品零售总额）
jargon.explain: 老百姓花钱消费的总量，反映内需强弱。升=消费旺，降=消费弱。
jargon.explain_en: Total consumer spending, reflecting domestic demand strength.

jargon.explain: 通过沪港通/深港通从香港流入A股的资金，被视为外资风向标。
jargon.explain_en: Capital flowing from HK into A-shares via Stock Connect, seen as foreign capital barometer.

jargon.explain: 国际大宗商品以美元计价。美元贵了，同样一桶油用美元买就贵了，需求减少，价格就跌。
jargon.explain_en: Commodities priced in USD. Stronger dollar = more expensive commodities = lower demand.

jargon.explain: 市场害怕风险时，资金从股票等高风险资产流向黄金/美债等安全资产。
jargon.explain_en: When markets fear risk, capital flows from stocks to safe havens like gold/Treasuries.

jargon.explain: 衡量制造业/服务业景气度的指标。50以上=扩张，50以下=收缩。
jargon.explain_en: Index measuring manufacturing/services activity. Above 50 = expansion, below 50 = contraction.

historical_analogies.event: 2014-2015年美元走强周期：大宗商品全面崩塌
historical_analogies.event_en: 2014-2015 Strong Dollar Cycle: Broad commodity collapse
historical_analogies.lesson: 2014-2015年美元指数从80涨至100，黄金从1300跌至1050，原油从100跌至30。美元走强周期中大宗商品无一幸免。
historical_analogies.lesson_en: 2014-2015: DXY 80 to 100, gold $1300 to $1050, oil $100 to $30. Strong dollar cycle spares no commodity.
historical_analogies.diff: 需关注美联储实际加息路径是否如预期，以及通胀是否支撑继续加息。当前美元周期位置与2014年不同。
historical_analogies.diff_en: Watch whether the Fed actually hikes as expected and whether inflation supports further hikes. Current dollar cycle position differs from 2014.
